name: VS Velocity Baton

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Confined Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch parameters are particularly stable.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Countermass
perks.desc:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Hard Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is optimized for projectile speed.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Quick Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's barrel provides faster projectiles and much faster aiming.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Increases projectile speed

perks.name: Smart Drift Control
perks.desc:
This barrel is broadly optimized for firing control.
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Implosion Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles travel faster and have a controlled explosion.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: Proximity Grenades
perks.desc: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.desc: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

perks.name: Under-Over
perks.desc: Deals bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Reverberation
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for a short duration.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Slickdraw
perks.desc: Significantly increases handling, significantly decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Dimensional Shift
perks.desc: Collecting a Void Breach causes final blows to provide a Void Overshield.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.desc: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.desc: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.desc: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Bray Legacy
perks.desc: Damage with this weapon generates a small amount of ability energy for the one closest to a full charge.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "This is probably my favorite weapon to come out of this dungeon. The amount of orbs you can generate is almost as strong as OG Tether back in Year 1 Eater of Worlds. Lorathexplorer almost crashed my game multiple times with how many orbs she made. For general use Attrition Orbs is great but I feel the perk interaction is slightly unintended. You do have the Void Synergy, but outside of that it is a nice area denial frame for the energy slot versus the kinetic." Recommended MW: Blast Radius or Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "I beg you, don't use this in PvP. Witherhorde is unique in that you can stick people, but outside of that it's…well…bad. You can definitely try in Control to cover a capture point but it doesn't stay long enough or do enough tick damage to really become a neusance." Recommended MW: Blast Radius.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 120 from 29 October 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3tLWOteO62mxx6Yh2Ll4k3?si=bb40d9918c564281) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE utility pick for general and end-game, underleveled content. VS Velocity Baton is the only second Area Denial GL if you 've been looking for a void flamethrower. The stats look pretty good, with pretty much all stats a little better than Lost Signal. With 0/1/2/3 reserves, you have 24/25/25/25 total ammo. For the barrel and mag perks, look to boost velocity without damaging Blast Radius. You'll likely be looking to Attrition Orbs in the second trait perk column and its ability to print multiple orbs with each shot - it's not clear yet whether this is bugged and in need of a nerf (but it kinda feels like it might). To pair with that in the first trait column, Demolitionist should get grenade ability back quickly to use as a reload perk, Under-Over should quickly cook non-matching elemental shields and the hidden damage resistance shields of Subjugators, or Unrelenting provides health regeneration. If you have access to void debuffs, Repulsor Brace is another option, to gain Void Overshields. The Bray Legacy origin trait is useful in PvE, working in the background to add ability energy to the one closest to a full charge on every tick of weapon damage. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, a Tactical mod for bumps to handling and Reload Speed, Synergy to generate Void Breaches, or Stunloader when there's a matching artifact mod.
